rawRecord.name: Korture
rawRecord.short_description: Analyze job descriptions with Korture's behavioral hiring platform to identify key role behaviors, assign demand levels, and generate interview questions via OAuth-authenticated MCP.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Korture converts job descriptions into behavioral measurement briefs through its hiring assessment platform, identifying five key behaviors required for a role, assigning demand levels from one to five, and generating targeted interview questions. The MCP server provides a stateless wrapper over the Korture API with OAuth 2.1 PKCE authentication and is deployed on Vercel.
